verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a dedicated sandbox as a self-contained virtual environment mirroring production, explicitly designed so apps (including the agentic-commerce cart API and agent toolkit) can be tested without touching live accounts, using sandbox credentials. Agent-commerce flows run on the same REST surface, so sandbox testing extends to agent tooling. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that agent-specific flows (cart API, MCP server, Store Sync) work seamlessly in sandbox mode rather than just general REST APIs.
